## Context / Problem
The tests/integration/rebar_reconciler cohort contains 29 editable prose blocks across the 11 recorded file-impact paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

The prose inventory and immutable before-citations are pinned to origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e. At plan repair time origin/main had advanced to 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396 only through unrelated workflow/grounding files; none of this ticket's scoped blobs changed. Implement from current origin/main, but keep 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e as the immutable prose-audit basis. The final leaf change is one commit, so changed-path checks use HEAD^..HEAD rather than the audit-base aggregate.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments and docstrings at the stable anchors below. Do not edit executable statements, assertions, runtime string literals, directives, or unlisted prose.

For every Python path, parse base and final source with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True). Recursively remove only the leading Expr(Constant(str)) from bodies of Module, ClassDef, FunctionDef, and AsyncFunctionDef; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; then require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Separately preserve directive text and attachment because comments are absent from the AST.

A non-author reviewer must post one leaf-linked TSV row per edited block:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Before and after citations use full immutable commit SHAs. Both verdict columns must be PASS; missing rows block closure.

## Scope — 29 editable blocks
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py — _default_jira_project docstring. Preserve required project value, override behavior, and cleanup.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/_fakes.py — module, FakeAcliClient, and install docstrings. Preserve verbatim captured shapes, deep-copy isolation, matching signatures, and the production injection seam.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_jira_fixtures.py — module docstring and comment beginning "Ticket 88d9 INVERTED…". Preserve complementary secret scrubbing and the top-level-parent presence/falsy oracle.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_roundtrip.py — module docstring. Preserve the production-path bidirectional comment/link/parent round trip.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_snapshot_contract.py — module docstring plus docstrings of test_producer_carries_enrichment_keys and test_inbound_reads_comment_field_and_would_miss_prefix. Preserve producer/consumer shape and discriminating nested-comment/link/parent oracles.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_verified_fake_contract.py — module docstring and comment beginning "The honesty mechanism…". Preserve shared-contract execution and the deliberately divergent-fake negative control.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_leaves_invocable.py — module and test_outbound_probe_leaf_genuinely_invocable docstrings. Preserve linkage versus observable invocability.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_link_sync.py — module and both test docstrings. Describe the implemented bidirectional ADD-only link synchronization, not "DESIRED/TDD/possibly not-yet-implemented"; retain Jira direction and representative payload shape.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_post_deletion_linkage.py — module docstring, comment beginning ("inbound", "delete")…, and test_leaves_registry_linkage_intact docstring. Preserve the exact surviving leaf registry and linkage-versus-invocability scope.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py — module docstring, clock comment in test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head, and test_out_of_window_404_then_alive_roundtrip_clears_absence docstring. Preserve non-vacuous git-backed setup, lifecycle clock injection, and two-pass zero-write behavior.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py — module docstring, comment beginning "Ticket 4af8…", description/oversize-description/link-roundtrip test docstrings, and comment beginning "Apply the link to the Jira snapshot…". Preserve chained fixed-point purpose, ADF truncation protection, link direction, and no-churn/no-echo outcomes.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest executes the nine test modules. conftest.py autouse fixtures serve this subtree. _fakes.py is imported by test_jira_fixtures.py, test_roundtrip.py, test_snapshot_contract.py, and test_verified_fake_contract.py. scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Preserve exactly, attached to the same executable statements:
- test_link_sync.py: # type: ignore[union-attr]
- test_reconcile_idempotency.py: # type: ignore[union-attr]
- test_reconcile_idempotency.py: # type: ignore[attr-defined]
- test_reconcile_roundtrip.py: # type: ignore[union-attr]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 29 allowlisted prose blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Normalized Python ASTs are exactly equal between 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e and the final commit.
- [ ] All four protected directives retain exact text and attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Sorted paths changed by the single leaf commit HEAD^..HEAD exactly equal the 11 recorded file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV contains exactly one passing row for every edited block, with full before/final SHAs.
- [ ] The semantic, directive, path-set, diff, hygiene, focused-test, and full-repository commands recorded under Verification pass.

## Verification
Run every structured verify command. The AST and directive comparators are the executable semantic guards; the independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality. Focused pytest executes the nine real test modules and intentionally excludes helper-only conftest.py and _fakes.py.
